visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair tied in a low ponytail, wearing a grey sparkling tube top with a matching choker and light blue denim jeans, sits on a grey concrete ledge against a textured concrete wall. She holds a red rose and plucks its petals one by one with a sad, contemplative facial expression. (2) A close-up shot focuses on her face; she looks down at a rose petal she is holding near her mouth, her expression full of sorrow. The lighting is bright and natural, casting soft shadows. (3) The scene cuts to a full-body view of the same woman standing in the same urban location, now smiling broadly and performing an energetic dance routine. She moves her arms rhythmically and waves at the camera while spinning around. (4) A first-person perspective shows the camera moving forward across a paved walkway scattered with red rose petals. A hand enters the frame from below and picks up one of the petals from the ground. (5) The POV hand presents the petal to the woman, who is now standing and looking hopeful. She cups her hands to receive the petal and smiles radiantly at the camera as colorful pink heart and light graphics appear around her.
